title: Don't Say "I'm Sorry" – Say This Instead #shorts
description:
Don't say "I'm sorry". Say this instead:
• My bad. (very casual)
• Sorry about that. (everyday)
• I apologise. (formal)
• That was my fault. (when you take the blame)
• Pardon me. (polite, when you bump into someone)

Which one will you try today? Write it in the comments.
